html:
Ninh Binh Tourism in April brings visitors to a peaceful land, where the pristine beauty is still preserved, with cool green rice fields, blue rivers, surrounded by mountains that look like a rustic countryside painting, in the distance are villages hidden next to the mountains.

In April, Ninh Binh begins to enter summer, bringing with it a changing climate, gradually from spring to summer, each season Ninh Binh brings visitors a unique beauty, but April is the season of lotus flowers blooming, visitors can take beautiful pictures of the blooming lotus season.

Ninh Binh’s weather in April is not as hot as in May and June. Therefore, Ninh Binh in April is still a destination chosen by many tourists, the temperature at this time is around 25 degrees Celsius, there is no rain, so traveling to Ninh Binh in April, the weather is quite nice for visitors to visit and sightsee.

Ninh Binh tourist attractions in April

1. Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Traveling to Ninh Binh in April, you should visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, which is not only known for its two temples of King Dinh Tien Hoang and King Le Dai Hanh, but also welcomes visitors with famous landmarks, natural scenery that blends together to create a poetic picture.

2. Trang An

Recognized by UNESCO as a heritage site in 2014, traveling to Trang An in April, you should take a boat to admire the scenery, surrounded by limestone mountains below is a clear blue stream, you take a boat to admire the charming scenery.

When the boat is gently on the lake, you will see each cave or ancient pagoda, you will feel like you are lost in a fairyland, with clear blue moss water, you can see all the way to the bottom.

3. Tam Coc

Coming here, visitors not only admire the natural scenery but also feel the scenery of a countryside, that peaceful scenery is an ideal destination for every tourist’s vacation tour when coming to Ninh Binh, many tourists still choose Ninh Binh vacation tour in April.

4. Thung Nham Bird Garden

As a world natural heritage site, surrounded by high mountains that look like a watercolor painting, especially when coming here, visitors also visit the caves, especially the scene of flocks of birds flying in the sky, you can save for yourself beautiful pictures, will definitely bring you the most unforgettable feeling, when you have the opportunity to set foot in Ninh Binh.

5. Bai Dinh Pagoda

The pagoda is located majestically with a unique design, and is very sophisticatedly sculpted, from here visitors can admire the peaceful scenery, and admire its own beauty and is an indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary.

What to eat when traveling to Ninh Binh in April?

Goat meat: One of the famous specialties in Ninh Binh, goat meat is processed into many different delicious dishes such as: raw goat with lemon, goat hotpot, or grilled goat… so when traveling to Ninh Binh in April, goat meat is a delicious dish that visitors must enjoy.

Crispy rice: A famous specialty in Ninh Binh, visitors not only enjoy but also buy as gifts.

Yen Mac sour sausage: The sausage here is made with fresh spices, creating a harmonious combination of sweet and sour flavors, if you travel Ninh Binh in April, don’t forget to buy sour sausage as gifts.

Eel salad: A famous specialty of Ninh Binh, with the softness of the eel fish combined with the spices mixed together to bring diners an irresistible aroma.

Mountain snails: A famous specialty in Ninh Binh, snails often live in mountain crevices, the snail meat is fragrant, chewy, sweet and very nutritious, chosen by many gourmets.

Kim Son wine: When talking about delicious dishes, we cannot help but mention delicious wine, this is one of the wines that Ninh Binh people naturally ferment, so it is very delicious.

Eel vermicelli: April is summer in Ninh Binh, so you should enjoy a bowl of eel vermicelli, which is not only delicious but also cool, and watching the scenery of Ninh Binh in the changing seasons is nothing more interesting.

Ant egg sticky rice: A special dish, the ants here are brought by people from the mountains, so it naturally brings a natural fragrance, which cannot be found anywhere else.

Fish braised in a hot pot: The fish are caught fresh, cleaned and braised in a hot pot, brought out to enjoy, giving off a natural fragrance. If you travel to Ninh Binh in April, you should not miss this dish of Fish braised in a hot pot.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Ninh Binh in April, hopefully it will help your trip, wish you a happy vacation with Vietlook Travel.
